name: severity:critical
description: Critical impact: core functionality unavailable, data loss, or severe security exposure.

name: severity:high
description: Major impact: important functionality is broken with no practical workaround.

name: severity:medium
description: Moderate impact: functionality is impaired, but a practical workaround exists.

name: severity:low
description: Minor impact: limited disruption, cosmetic defects, or small usability issues.

name: priority:P0
description: Immediate: address before other planned work; blocks release or ongoing operations.

name: priority:P1
description: High: schedule in the next available work cycle.

name: priority:P2
description: Normal: schedule through regular backlog planning.

name: priority:P3
description: Low: address when capacity permits; may be deferred.
